_source_notes.encounter_multipliers: DMG Chapter 13, republished in Wizards of the Coast Basic Rules (2014), via D&D Beyond. Not present in the project SRD 5.1 file.
_source_notes.adventuring_day_xp: DMG Chapter 13, republished in Wizards of the Coast Basic Rules (2014), via D&D Beyond. Not present in the project SRD 5.1 file.
_source_notes.xp_by_challenge_rating: Confirmed directly from the project SRD 5.1 file (Experience Points by Challenge Rating table).

xp_thresholds_by_character_level._description: Per-character XP threshold for each difficulty tier. Sum across all party members to get the party's threshold for a given tier.

encounter_multipliers._description: Multiply total monster XP by this value, based on monster count, before comparing to the party's XP threshold. Assumes a party of 3-5 characters; see party_size_adjustment.

party_size_adjustment._description: If the party has fewer than 3 characters, use the next highest multiplier column. If the party has 6 or more characters, use the next lowest multiplier column.

adventuring_day_xp._description: Rough total adjusted XP a single character can absorb across a full adventuring day before needing a long rest. Sum across the party for a day-level budget, not a single-encounter budget.
